lines.lyric: Where you going? Don’t let em flow it
lines.lyric_hangul: Where you going? Don't let 'em flow it
lines.lyric_translation: Where you going? Don’t let em flow it

lines.lyric: Kono boku dake nokoshite
lines.lyric_hangul: この僕だけ残して
lines.lyric_translation: Leaving me behind

lines.lyric: Konnanimo I want it more
lines.lyric_hangul: こんなにも I want it more
lines.lyric_translation: So much, I want it more

lines.lyric: Ima sukoshi demo ii kara
lines.lyric_hangul: 今、少しでもいいから
lines.lyric_translation: Right now, even if it’s just a little bit

lines.lyric: Tomaranai tokei no hari Don’t leave me all alone
lines.lyric_hangul: 止まらない時計の針 Don't leave me all alone
lines.lyric_translation: Hands of the clock don’t stop Don’t leave me all alone

lines.lyric: Hitori de omoidebanashi ni shinaide mo
lines.lyric_hangul: ひとりで思い出話にしないでもう
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t take it as the days gone by

lines.lyric: Boku dake de iru kimochi ni naru kara
lines.lyric_hangul: 僕だけでいる気持ちになるから
lines.lyric_translation: It makes me feel alone

lines.lyric: Okizari ni naritakunai yo Take me to you now
lines.lyric_hangul: 置き去りになりたくないよ Take me to you now
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t wanna be left behind, take me to you now

lines.lyric: Too fast kimi ni awase mata korobi
lines.lyric_hangul: Too fast 君に合わせまた転び
lines.lyric_translation: Too fast I tried to keep up with you but fell again

lines.lyric: Boku wa imadani koko ni iru yo
lines.lyric_hangul: 僕は未だにここにいるよ
lines.lyric_translation: I’m still right here

lines.lyric: Mae ni bokura ga aruita kono michi de
lines.lyric_hangul: 前に僕らが歩いたこの道で
lines.lyric_translation: On the path we used to take

lines.lyric: Hitori walking on the way
lines.lyric_hangul: ひとり Walking on the way
lines.lyric_translation: Alone, walking on the way

lines.lyric: Hiesugiru yo so cold
lines.lyric_hangul: 冷え過ぎるよ So cold
lines.lyric_translation: It’s so cold, so cold

lines.lyric: Sukoshi zutsu ashi omoku nari slow mode
lines.lyric_hangul: 少しずつ足重くなり Slow mode
lines.lyric_translation: Feel my steps becoming heavier, slow mode

lines.lyric: Saki ni ita boku no sugata wa black or white
lines.lyric_hangul: 先にいた僕の姿は Black or white
lines.lyric_translation: Seeing myself as it’s black or white

lines.lyric: Shashin no yo naru kako no mono to
lines.lyric_hangul: 写真の様なる過去のものと
lines.lyric_translation: Like a photo, a thing of the past

lines.lyric: Hitori kirini naru no ga kowakute
lines.lyric_hangul: ひとりきりになるのが怖くて
lines.lyric_translation: Afraid of being alone

lines.lyric: Yume noseta kisha mo ugokanaku natteku
lines.lyric_hangul: 夢乗せた汽車も動かなくなってく
lines.lyric_translation: Train full of dreams gradually halting

lines.lyric: Boku dake ga me no mae no Island
lines.lyric_hangul: 僕だけが目の前のIsland
lines.lyric_translation: I stand before an island, almost there but

lines.lyric: Mada todokanasode kowainda mo ey
lines.lyric_hangul: まだ届かなそうで怖いんだ もう ey
lines.lyric_translation: Scares me that it seems out of reach, ey

lines.lyric: Hiru mo yoru mo nayami Cry
lines.lyric_hangul: 昼も夜も悩みCry
lines.lyric_translation: Day and night, always in anguish, cry

lines.lyric: Onaji basho de kawarinai
lines.lyric_hangul: 同じ場所で変わりない
lines.lyric_translation: Still in the same place

lines.lyric: Ari ki tari no kyoku ya kashi ga mae to nani mo kawaranai
lines.lyric_hangul: ありきたりの曲や歌詞が 前と何も変わらない
lines.lyric_translation: Unremarkable songs and lyrics are not changed at all

lines.lyric_hangul: 身を正していつも恥ずかしくない様にして yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Straightening up, / making sure I’m presentable yeah

lines.lyric: Kagami miru tokini wa warai jibun wo tsuyoku motte
lines.lyric_hangul: 鏡見る時には笑い自分を強く持って
lines.lyric_translation: Smile when I look into the mirror, try to be strong

lines.lyric: Sarakedashite taisei no hito no mae de shoumei
lines.lyric_hangul: さらけだして大勢の人の前で証明
lines.lyric_translation: Bared my soul and proved myself in front of the crowd

lines.lyric: Tama ni jishin nakute
lines.lyric_hangul: たまに自信なくて
lines.lyric_translation: But sometimes I lose confidence

lines.lyric: Kono sugata subete ga ey
lines.lyric_hangul: この姿すべてが ey
lines.lyric_translation: My entirety, ey

lines.lyric: Boku igai no mina ga saki ni susunde
lines.lyric_hangul: 僕以外の皆が先に進んで
lines.lyric_translation: Everyone besides me has gone ahead

lines.lyric: Itsumo tonari ni ita yatsu mo touku nari mou mienai
lines.lyric_hangul: いつも隣にいたやつも遠くなりもう見えない
lines.lyric_translation: Those used to stand beside me went far away, can’t see them any more

lines.lyric: Anymore yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: Anymore yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Anymore yeah, yeah
